patthana22.36:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.36:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. satta.
patthana22.36:3.1: na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho araṇo uppajjati hetupaccayā, satta. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na araṇañca na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ na araṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. satta.
patthana22.36:7.1: na sanidassana sappaṭigho na araṇo dhammo sanidassana sappaṭighassa araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, satta.
patthana22.36:8.1: na anidassana sappaṭigho na araṇo dhammo sanidassana sappaṭighassa araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, satta.
patthana22.36:9.1: na sanidassana sappaṭigho na araṇo ca dhammā anidassana sappaṭigho na araṇo ca dhammā sanidassana sappaṭighassa araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo, satta.
patthana22.36:10.1: na sanidassana sappaṭigho na araṇo dhammo anidassana appaṭighassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo, na anidasna sappaṭigho na araṇo dhammo anidassana appaṭighassa araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo,
patthana22.36:11.1: hetuyā ekavīsa, ārammaṇe tīṇi. avigate ekavīsa,
patthana22.36:12.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccanīyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.) paccanīyānuloma tikaduka paṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
